verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no public API for EFTPS. The only software channel is the downloadable Batch Provider Software for tax professionals, which the evidence explicitly describes as 'not an API'. The voice response system is interchangeable with the website, but it is a phone channel, not programmatic access. Probes for OpenAPI and Swagger specs all returned 404, so nothing shows API parity with the UI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
